Phase 2: retired the three demonstration-only LiftViaMorphism.lean overlays (~607 lines) plus their Cslib.lean imports and a stale prose mention. Phase 3: Cluster C resolved via a mixed hoist/fallback outcome -- discovered and wired up a pre-existing, previously-unused Foundations helper (GenericMCS.deriv_iff_algebraic_of_forward) for Propositional and Modal's *_deriv_iff_algebraic (net line reduction); Temporal and Bimodal's base bridges cannot take the same route (bespoke InferenceSystem tags fail HilbertTree instance search against the assembler), so those got a documenting comment instead, per the plan's own fallback provision. Phase 4: full CSLib CI pipeline (lake build/checkInitImports/lint/lint-style/test) verified green, zero sorry, no new axioms.
